title: Transcranial FUS Therapy and Monitoring using Nonlinear Acoustics
summary: Focused ultrasound (FUS) offers a promising, non-invasive method for modulating neural activity and delivering therapies deep within the brain with immense clinical potential. However, progress in developing transcranial ultrasound (TUS) for clinical applications has been hindered by several factors. The complexity of the human skull causes focal aberrations and attenuation, thereby presenting a major obstacle to the precise targeting of ultrasound waves.
